description_expanded: 30A ESCAPES invites you to “Endless Summer Escape” in Seacrest Beach! This pet-friendly retreat is just a 4-min walk to the 12,000 sqft Lagoon Pool and close to Rosemary and Alys Beach. Enjoy a fully-equipped kitchen, stylish décor, and spacious living areas. Included are 6 beach bikes for exploring nearby shops, dining, and seaside views. Perfect for families, friends, and their pets, this getaway blends relaxation and adventure. Create lifelong memories—book your stay today!*** HIGHLIGHTS *** Just a 4-Min Walk to the Stunning Lagoon Pool – 12,000 sq ft of clear water, a splash zone, and ultimate relaxation await nearby. Pet Friendly – Bring your dog on your vacation (fees and restrictions apply)! 6 Bikes Included – Cruise through the scenic 30A area, feel the ocean breeze, and discover hidden gems effortlessly. Seasonal Tram Service – Stress-free beach days await! Let the tram take you straight to the soft, sandy shores. Walking Distance to Rosemary and Alys Beach – Walk to charming shops, dining, and the vibrant energy of iconic 30A destinations in under 10 minutes. Perfect for Groups – Plenty of space for family or friends to relax, bond, and make memories together.Eager to Read More?Here Are A Few Kind Words From Our Previous Guests: "The house was clean, spacious, and perfectly located near the pool and beach. We couldn’t have asked for a better family vacation!" – Brittany A. "The bikes included were such a thoughtful touch. Exploring the community was a highlight of our trip!" – Michele B. "Absolutely loved our relaxing stay here. The décor is beautiful, and everything was so convenient!" – Katherine H.*** LIVING AREA ***Unwind in a spacious, sunlit living area infused with coastal charm. A cozy sectional sofa and smart TV set the stage for perfect movie nights, while the inviting front porch provides a serene spot to soak up the breeze. Open layout with beach-chic décor Sectional sofa with a smart TV Front porch with seating for four*** KITCHEN AND DINING ***Cook, dine, and BBQ with ease in the fully-equipped kitchen and outdoor spaces. Inside, enjoy stainless steel appliances and a wet bar with a wine fridge. Outside, fire up the grill on the porch for perfect BBQs. Gather around the dining table for 8 or enjoy quick meals at the breakfast bar. Modern kitchen with stainless steel appliances Wet bar with wine fridge for entertaining Dining table (seats 8) and breakfast bar (seats 2) Grill on the back porch*** BEDROOMS & BATHROOMS ***1st Floor: Guest Bedroom: King Bed with dedicated shared bathroom Full Bathroom: Walk-in Shower, Single Vanity2nd Floor: Primary Suite: King Bed, private balcony, flat-screen TV, En-suite with Walk-in Shower, Jacuzzi Tub, Double Vanity Guest Bedroom: Queen Bed, shared Jack & Jill Bathroom Bunk Bedroom: Twin-Over-Full Bunk (shared Jack & Jill Bathroom)*** LOCATION, OUTDOOR & COMMUNITY AMENITIES ***Nestled in the vibrant Seacrest Beach community, this home offers easy access to local attractions and top-notch amenities. Walk or bike to the Lagoon Pool, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach, or explore the shops, dining, and live music at Peddler’s Pavilion. Equipped with 6 beach bikes, it makes exploring the area both easy and enjoyable. 12,000 sq ft Lagoon Pool – A stunning paradise with a zero-entry splash zone, waterfalls, and plenty of loungers, plus a poolside café and picnic areas. Beach Access – Enjoy a seasonal tram for easy transportation or take a short 10-minute stroll to the emerald Gulf waters. 6 Bikes Included – Perfect for exploring nearby attractions like Peddler’s Pavilion, Rosemary Beach, and Alys Beach. Peddler’s Pavilion – Just a 2-minute bike ride or 5-minute walk to boutique shops, live music, dining, and seasonal nightlife. Scenic Walking & Nature Trails – Picturesque paths just steps from the house, ideal for exploration and relaxation. Walkable, Bike-Friendly Community – Conveniently access beautiful destinations all around. South Walton’s Tallest Sand Dunes – A unique and stunning natural feature of the area. Rosemary Beach (8-min walk) and Alys Beach (10-min walk) – Explore charming coastal communities nearby. Carillon Beach (7-min drive) – More coastal beauty just minutes away.*** PET-FRIENDLY *** Pets are not allowed on furniture, beds, or in the pool. Dogs must be crated when left unattended by guests. Non-refundable pet fee: $250 + tax.*** OTHER THINGS TO KNOW *** Travel Insurance is NOT included in our quotes. It can be purchased during the reservation process or obtained independently. We DO NOT accept wire transfers for payment. This property has 6 bikes for guest use. To utilize the bikes, a waiver must be signed before the code is provided to the guest. Additional bikes can be rented through 30A Escapes. LSVs are not allowed in Rosemary Beach, Seacrest, or Alys Beach. Pet-friendly with a non-refundable pet fee of $250 + tax.*** BOOK TODAY & START YOUR 30A ESCAPE! ***TDT #: 43200STRO #: STR-043200
